A Hacker News participant describes a prolonged software-engineering job search, financial pressure and possible work outside the field. The examined opening discussion offers personal accounts of referrals, recruiting filters, consulting and adjacent roles.

These are unverified individual experiences, not a representative employment survey or proof that AI caused the person’s unemployment. Suggestions about business registration, résumé presentation or jobs require independent checks before use. This summary covers the examined opening rather than every later comment.
highlights: Opening post is a personal account
AI mention does not establish job-loss causation
Fees and legal advice were not verified
